messages:
maria: Morning team — quick async pulse.
What I did: demo'd Dedicated pilot with NovaHealth ops; they asked for BYOK + HSM details.
Blockers: legal requested a keywrap diagram and HSM latency SLAs. Need eng numbers to close.
Today: follow up w/ eng-infra + security, update onboarding doc and circulate to AE.

devon: Thanks Maria. Raised internal ticket with eng-infra for HSM latency/throughput. Also have a pending PR (#482) to update KMS integration docs — will push tests today.

oliver: Quick question — for BYOK we can offer either KMS-proxy (no HSM) or HSM-backed KEK rotation. Which does the customer prefer? HSM is slower but meets compliance.

maria: They explicitly asked for HSM-backed in the call. Can we get a 2-3 bullet pros/cons list to send them? Also need a sample SSO/SCIM snippet for their IdP.

sarah: I can draft the SCIM example. Quick snippet below for their SREs to test:
```json
{
  "scim": "2.0",
  "entitlement": "sso-saml",
  "attributes": ["email","groups","displayName"]
}
```
I'll open a gist and link it when ready.

anya: Heads up — security needs confirmation on audit log retention for Private deployments before we sign. What retention are we committing to?

sec-bot: [security-check] Intake scan: NovaHealth intake missing explicit audit retention. Required by policy: 12 months. Please confirm and add to onboarding documentation. :warning:

devon: I'll add the 12-month retention note to the onboarding doc and attach legal's keywrap diagram. Will ping once updated.

maria: Perfect. I'll sync with the customer tonight and ask them to confirm HSM acceptance. If anyone has HSM latency/throughput numbers (p50/p95 for 512-token contexts) drop them here; otherwise I'll ping eng-oncall tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
